title: Magnolia Breeze | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Magnolia Breeze is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Magnolia Breeze sits on one of the largest lots in the Grove by the Sea, giving you plenty of space to settle in and enjoy your 30A getaway. With 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this home comfortably accommodates up to 9 guests, making it an ideal retreat for your family or friends. Take a leisurely 10 minute walk to the beach or explore the quiet streets of Seagrove at your own pace. Surrounded by natural beauty, Magnolia Breeze invites you to slow down, connect, and make meaningful memories together.Inside, the bright open layout and high ceilings create a warm, welcoming atmosphere. You can curl up on the sofa in the living room for movie nights, or open the doors to the screened porch and let the coastal breeze flow in. A bonus room with a barn door gives you extra space to read, play games, or accommodate additional sleeping arrangements with its queen sleeper sofa and half bathroom. The fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, and more makes it easy for you to prepare meals, share breakfast at the island with bar seating, or gather around the dining table for six.Upstairs, you’ll find the master suite with a king bed, a TV, and its own private screened porch where you can start your morning with coffee and fresh air. The bathroom features dual vanities, a jetted tub, and a walk in shower. The second bedroom includes a queen bed and TV, while the bunk room with a twin over twin and an additional twin bed is perfect for kids, giving them their own comfortable space. A shared bathroom with a tub and shower combo and a washer and dryer are also conveniently located upstairs. Outside, you can enjoy evening barbecues on the grill and dine beneath the shade of the surrounding trees.Beach Access:Head down N. Andalusia Ave. and follow this road across 30A and you’ll find your beach access.Distance: .4 miles | Time: 10 minutes walkingGrove by the Sea:Grove by the Sea is a peaceful, tree lined community located just across from the emerald beaches of South Walton. Beach access is an easy walk from the homes, and the neighborhood features two pools, one of which is seasonally heated, along with a tennis court. Stroll along tree lined paths, relax on spacious green areas, or explore the community and nearby beach at your own pace. Whether you spend your days swimming, playing, or enjoying the outdoors, Grove by the Sea provides a wonderful base to enjoy the charm of 30A with family and friends.Nearby Attractions:You’ll be just minutes from some of the best local favorites on 30A. Bike to Seaside or WaterColor for shopping and casual bites, enjoy seafood at Old Florida Fish House, or savor a memorable dinner at Café 30A. Seagrove Market is perfect for a laid-back lunch, and The Big Chill offers live music and family fun in the evenings. From pedaling along scenic trails to savoring fresh Gulf flavors and watching the sunset over the water, your time at Magnolia Breeze connects you with authentic 30A experiences you’ll never forget.Your stay at Magnolia Breeze comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 3 cars, with a long driveway that allows extra parking.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
